Thanks for the form and voided check. Two small asks before Finance/AP can process: 
1) Please attach a current W9 (we need a tax name match and EIN).
2) Please confirm the primary signatory who authorized the bank change and provide an email from that person or a signed letter on company letterhead.

If you need the vendor portal flow to be faster, we can set an expedited review (requires procurement + finance approval).
